options.text: Expose storage or mutable state to the caller so the caller can decide the rule after reading the current representation.

Keep behavior with the state and rule it protects unless a separate policy boundary is explicit. In this case, that keeps the rule “conflicts are explicit and never silently overwrite accepted geometry” inside the owner that can observe and enforce it.
